Schnittstelle XorValue<L,R>

Typparameter:
L - the type of the left value
R - the type of the right value
Alle Superschnittstellen:
Supplier<R>, Value<R>
Alle bekannten Unterschnittstellen:
Either<L,R>, Result<A>
Alle bekannten Implementierungsklassen:
Either.Left, Either.Right, Result.Failure, Result.Success
public interface XorValue<L,R> extends Value<R>

Disjoint two‑way value container: holds exactly one value, either on the left of type L or on the right of type R. If there is no left value, there must be a right value, and vice versa.

This interface extends Value<R> and treats the presence of the right value as the notion of “being present”. Consequently, isPresent() mirrors isRight(), and get() returns the right value (or throws if absent).
